what: Rebase probe exit code is swallowed after moving 7a.r inside step-7a.sh
scenario_or_breakage: Existing Rebase Checkpoint Macro branches on the probe process exit code; the plan says step-7a.sh exits 0 for all non-argv paths, so a 7a.r conflict or failed rebase can be misrouted as success after only REBASE_OUTCOME appears in stdout
suggested_fix: Add an explicit REBASE_PROBE_RC or preserve the probe exit for 1/3, update SKILL.md Step 7a routing to branch on that value instead of step-7a.sh rc, and add conflict and failed-rebase harness cases

what: Sanitizer rejection detection and test fixture do not match the real helper contract
scenario_or_breakage: generate-code-flow-diagram.sh emits STATUS=skipped with raw REASON_TOKEN values such as pipe-in-node-label, while the plan tests STATUS=failed SKIP_REASON=sanitizer-rejected and detection looks for sanitizer/reject substrings; the accepted no-upsert sanitizer path can go untested and post the placeholder comment
suggested_fix: Define sanitizer rejection as STATUS=skipped from generate-code-flow-diagram.sh, or match the known REASON_TOKEN taxonomy, and change the harness to stub STATUS=skipped with a real token such as pipe-in-node-label

what: larch-log commit failure is required to be captured but the planned phase and tests only cover flush-execution-issues failure
scenario_or_breakage: The current Step 7a contract says larch-log.sh commit failures must be captured and appended under Tool Failures; the plan lists larch-log.sh commit as degraded but specifies command || true and no harness case for commit failure, so a failed pre-bump log commit may be silently lost
suggested_fix: Revise the plan to capture larch-log.sh commit stdout/stderr, append-tool-failure on non-zero, set LOG_FLUSH_STATUS=degraded, and add a harness case where larch-log.sh commit fails
